policy: Feeds that the company's own investor-relations page links to, found by scripts/probe_ir_sources.py on a GitHub runner (probe_run). A row is read only while its host's robots.txt is readable and allows us (checked every run). Not tested here and not to be generalised: a page without a feed link, or whose robots.txt refused us, is listed under 'not_available' with the probe's result for that page only.

not_available.note: The IR page was read (robots allowed or no robots.txt) and links no RSS feed; platform paths are not guessed.
robots.txt answered 403 to our user agent; treated as disallowed and the page was not read.
